<style id="px-shell-style">/* Content and task actions lead; auxiliary controls remain available on demand. */
:root{--px-topbar:72px}
.px-more-heading{display:none}
.workspace-content{padding-top:24px!important}
#energy-control{margin-bottom:18px!important}
#energy-control>summary{background:transparent!important;border:0!important;padding:6px 0!important;color:#657767!important;font-weight:400!important}
.la-section-links .product-scope:before,.la-section-links .product-scope:after{content:none!important}
#la-study-location,#la-practice-location{gap:6px 8px;margin-top:4px;margin-bottom:12px}
.product-scope{background:#edf1e8;border:1px solid transparent;min-height:36px!important}
.product-scope:hover{background:#e5eddf}
.product-row-meta{font-size:12px!important;line-height:1.65!important}
.px-source-note{border:0!important;padding:0!important;margin:4px 0 0!important;background:transparent!important;font-size:11px;color:#6c7c70}
.px-source-note>summary{padding:4px 0!important;min-height:0!important;background:transparent!important;border:0!important;font-size:11px!important;font-weight:400!important}
.px-source-note>p{margin:5px 0 0;font-size:12px;line-height:1.65}
.px-study-options{border:0!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;background:transparent!important;grid-column:2;grid-row:1/3}
.px-study-options>summary{padding:8px 0!important;font-size:12px!important;font-weight:400!important;border:0!important;background:transparent!important;cursor:pointer}
.px-study-options .product-quick-links{display:flex;margin-top:8px;gap:18px}
#daily-study-home .ds-heading{margin-bottom:18px}
#daily-study-home .ds-heading h1{font-size:28px;margin:6px 0 8px}
#daily-study-home .ds-eyebrow{display:none}
#daily-study-home .ds-setup{padding:24px}
#daily-study-home .ds-section-label{margin-bottom:14px}
#daily-study-home .ds-duration{margin-bottom:18px}
.px-daily-choices{border:1px solid #d8e1d2!important;background:#f8faf4!important;border-radius:10px;padding:0 16px!important;margin:12px 0 20px!important}
.px-daily-choices>summary{cursor:pointer;padding:14px 0!important;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:500!important;border:0!important;background:transparent!important}
.px-daily-choices>.ds-section-label{display:none}
.px-daily-choices[open]>.ds-skills{margin-top:4px}
.px-daily-choices .ds-selection-note{margin-bottom:12px;min-height:0}
.ds-dock{padding:12px 16px;gap:14px}
.ds-dock:not(.hs-expanded) .ds-dock-instruction,.ds-dock:not(.hs-expanded) [data-hs-secondary]{display:none!important}
#hs-details{display:inline-flex!important}
.ds-dock:not(.hs-expanded):not(.px-paused) #ds-pause{display:none!important}
.ds-dock:not(.hs-expanded) .ds-dock-time{display:none}
.ds-dock-title{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.ds-dock-label{margin-bottom:2px;letter-spacing:0}
.ds-dock-title{margin-bottom:0}
.ds-dock .ds-dock-actions{gap:7px}
.ds-dock .ds-dock-actions button{white-space:nowrap}
@media(max-width:700px){
 #workspace-navigation{top:auto!important;bottom:calc(79px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))!important;left:12px!important;right:12px!important;width:auto!important;height:auto!important;max-height:65dvh!important;border:1px solid #d5dfd1!important;border-radius:18px!important;padding:15px!important;box-shadow:0 12px 50px #163c3026;transform:translateY(calc(100% + 100px));overflow-y:auto}
 body.nav-open #workspace-navigation{transform:translateY(0)!important}
 #workspace-navigation .brand,#workspace-navigation .sidebar-goal,#workspace-navigation .sidebar-foot{display:none!important}
 #workspace-navigation nav{padding:0!important;gap:6px!important}
 #workspace-navigation nav button{min-height:52px!important;margin-top:0!important}
 .px-more-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 7px 12px;font-size:15px}
 #px-more-close{border:0;background:transparent;padding:8px;color:#5f7365;font-size:13px;min-height:40px}
 .workspace-content{padding:16px 16px 96px!important}
 .workspace-topbar{padding:8px 16px 6px!important;min-height:64px!important;gap:1px 8px}
 .workspace-topbar #save-status{font-size:10px!important;line-height:1.2}
 #energy-control{margin-bottom:12px!important}
 #energy-control>summary{font-size:11px!important;padding:3px 0!important}
 #la-study-quick{padding:15px 16px;margin-bottom:17px!important;gap:7px}
 .px-study-options{grid-column:1;grid-row:auto}
 .px-study-options>summary{padding:3px 0!important;font-size:11px!important}
 .product-content-group{margin-top:16px;margin-bottom:23px}
 .product-row-meta{font-size:12px!important}
 .product-content-title{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.55}
 .product-content-row{padding:15px!important;gap:8px}
 .product-scope{font-size:12px!important;min-height:36px!important;padding:9px 11px!important}
 .product-search{margin-top:10px}
 #study>.la-heading,#practice>.la-heading{margin-bottom:13px!important}
 #daily-study-home .ds-heading{margin-bottom:14px}
 #daily-study-home .ds-heading h1{font-size:24px;line-height:1.35}
 #daily-study-home .ds-heading>div>p:last-child{font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}
 #daily-study-home .ds-setup{padding:18px}
 #daily-study-home .ds-duration button{min-height:67px;padding:12px 7px}
 #daily-study-home .ds-duration button strong{font-size:25px}
 #daily-study-home .ds-duration{gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
 #daily-study-home .ds-section-label small{display:none}
 .px-daily-choices{margin:12px 0 16px!important;padding:0 12px!important}
 #daily-study-home .ds-start-row .ds-primary{width:100%;justify-content:space-between}
 #daily-study-home .ds-preview{padding:20px 18px}
 .ds-dock{width:calc(100vw - 20px);padding:10px 12px;gap:7px;bottom:calc(74px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))!important}
 .ds-dock-copy{width:100%;flex-basis:100%}
 .ds-dock-title{font-size:12px!important;line-height:1.35}
 .ds-dock-label{font-size:10px!important;line-height:1.2}
 .ds-dock .ds-dock-actions{width:100%;max-width:none;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-start;gap:6px}
 .ds-dock .ds-dock-actions button{min-height:40px!important;padding:8px 10px!important;font-size:12px!important}
 .ds-dock .ds-dock-actions .ds-primary{margin-left:auto}
 .ds-dock:not(.hs-expanded) .ds-dock-label{display:none}
 .ds-dock:not(.hs-expanded) .hs-rest-status{font-size:11px;line-height:1.4}
 body:not(.ds-dock-active) #toast,body:not(.ds-dock-active) .la-notice{bottom:calc(80px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));z-index:1200}
 .st-toolbar{bottom:calc(80px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))!important;z-index:1200!important;max-width:calc(100vw - 24px);flex-wrap:wrap}
 .px-reading main>.panel:not([hidden]){padding-left:0!important;padding-right:0!important}
 .px-reading .la-focus-nav{margin-bottom:16px}
 .px-reading .exam-case,.px-reading .case-bank,.px-reading .practice-part,.px-reading .unit-box{margin-left:0!important;margin-right:0!important}
 .px-reading .exam-case{padding:0!important;border:0!important;background:transparent!important;box-shadow:none!important}
 .px-reading .case-bank{padding:0!important;border:0!important;background:transparent!important}
 .px-reading .exam-case>summary{padding:14px 0!important;background:transparent!important}
 .px-reading .case-source{padding-left:0!important;padding-right:0!important}
}
</style><style id="pe-word-style">/* Word workspace: compact task surfaces; original routes and controls remain. */
body[data-pe-words] .ui-word-tabs{margin-bottom:16px!important}
#vocabulary-review .ui-word-heading{position:absolute!important;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap}
#vocabulary-review .ui-word-toolbar{margin-bottom:12px;max-width:760px}
#vocabulary-review .ui-learn-card{max-width:760px;min-height:0;padding:24px 30px;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:none}
#vocabulary-review .ui-learn-term{margin:18px 0 4px!important;font-size:38px!important}
#vocabulary-review .ui-learn-prompt{margin:12px 0!important}
#vocabulary-review .ui-reveal{margin:14px 0!important}
#vocabulary-review [hidden]{display:none!important}
#vocabulary-review .ui-learn-grades{margin-top:16px!important;padding-top:14px;gap:9px}
#vocabulary-review .ui-learn-grades button{min-height:52px;padding:10px 5px}
#vocabulary-review .ui-learn-grades span{display:none}
#vocabulary-review .ui-learn-note{margin:10px 0 0;font-size:11px}
#vocabulary-review .ui-learn-definition{margin:14px 0}
#vocabulary-review .ui-learn-definition blockquote{margin:12px 0;padding:3px 0 3px 13px}
#vocabulary-review .ui-learn-definition blockquote p{margin:4px 0}
#vocabulary-review .pe-word-feedback{font-size:12px;color:#466c4a;margin:14px 0 6px}
#vocabulary-review .pe-word-next{width:100%;border:0;border-radius:9px;background:#2c6144;color:#fff;min-height:46px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;margin-top:8px}
#vocabulary-review .ui-word-status:empty{display:none}
#vocabulary-review .ux-keyboard-note{font-size:11px;margin:8px 0;color:#667866}
#word-review #vr-stats{display:flex!important;gap:16px;margin:12px 0!important;flex-wrap:wrap}
#word-review #vr-stats>div{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:5px;padding:0!important;border:0;background:none;border-radius:0}
#word-review #vr-stats strong{font-size:20px}#word-review #vr-stats span{font-size:12px}
#word-review .ui-review-history-link{font-size:12px;text-align:left;margin:10px 0 16px}
#word-review>.vr-controls{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin:12px 0!important}
#word-review .pe-review-settings{width:100%;border:0;padding:0;background:none;margin-bottom:4px}
#word-review .pe-review-settings summary{font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;min-height:38px;padding:8px 0;color:#526f55}
#word-review .pe-review-settings select{width:100%;margin:4px 0 10px}
#word-review #vr-start:disabled,#word-review #vr-practice-all:disabled,#word-review #ui-spelling-check{display:none!important}
#word-review .pe-primary{background:#2c6144!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#2c6144!important}
#word-review .pe-review-onward{display:inline-block;margin:12px 0 20px;font-size:14px}
#word-review .pe-review-onward[hidden]{display:none}
#word-review.pe-review-active>header,#word-review.pe-review-active>.ui-subtitle,#word-review.pe-review-active>#vr-stats,#word-review.pe-review-active>.ui-review-history-link,#word-review.pe-review-active>.vr-controls,#word-review.pe-review-active>.vr-help,#word-review.pe-review-active>#ux-review-empty{display:none!important}
#word-review #vr-stage{scroll-margin-top:90px;padding:22px!important;border-radius:16px!important;box-shadow:none}
#word-review #vr-stage .vr-card-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
#word-review #vr-stage .vr-card-heading p{font-size:12px;flex:1;margin:0}
#word-review #vr-stage .vr-card-heading button{font-size:12px;min-height:38px;white-space:nowrap;padding:6px 10px}
#word-review #vr-stage .vr-kicker{font-size:12px;margin:16px 0 10px}
#word-review #vr-stage .vr-word{margin:12px 0;font-size:34px!important}
#word-review #vr-stage .vr-grades{gap:8px}
#word-review #vr-stage .vr-grades button{min-height:48px!important;font-size:12px;padding:8px 5px}
#word-review #vr-status:empty{display:none}
#word-library .vr-library{border:0;background:none;padding:0}
#word-library .vr-library>summary{display:none}
#word-library .vr-list-card{padding:18px!important;border-radius:12px!important;box-shadow:none!important}
#word-library .vr-list-card .vr-card-heading{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}
#word-library .vr-list-card h3{font-size:23px;margin-bottom:6px}
#word-library .vr-meaning-details{padding:0!important;margin:0!important;background:none;border:0}
#word-library .vr-meaning-details>summary,.pe-word-more>summary{font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;min-height:38px;padding:9px 0;color:#45694c}
.pe-word-more{border:0!important;background:transparent!important;border-radius:0!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important}
.pe-word-more[open]{padding-bottom:10px!important}
#word-library .pe-word-more .vr-controls{gap:8px;margin:10px 0!important}
#word-library .pe-word-more button,#lookup-learning .pe-word-more button{min-height:40px!important;font-size:13px!important}
#lookup-learning .lookup-top{display:block!important;margin:0 0 14px}
#lookup-learning .lookup-top h2{font-size:27px;margin:0}
#lookup-learning #ui-query-word{float:none;min-height:44px}
#lookup-learning .pe-history-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;margin:0 0 16px}
#lookup-learning #pe-history-more{position:relative}
#lookup-learning #pe-history-more[open] #lookup-export{display:block;margin-top:6px}
#lookup-learning #lookup-export{min-height:42px;white-space:nowrap}
#lookup-learning .lookup-record{padding:16px 0}
#lookup-learning .lookup-record .pe-word-more[open]{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
#lookup-learning .lookup-record .pe-word-more summary{width:100%}
#sentence-learning .pe-sentence-entry{display:block;margin-top:14px;font-weight:600;color:#285d3c}
#sentence-learning .st-actions{align-items:center;gap:16px}
@media(max-width:700px){
 body[data-pe-words] .ui-word-tabs{margin-bottom:12px!important}
 body[data-pe-words] .ui-word-tabs a{padding:8px 6px;font-size:12px}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-word-toolbar select{min-width:130px;max-width:165px}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-learn-card{padding:18px!important}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-topic-pill{font-size:10px;padding:4px 8px}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-learn-term{font-size:32px!important;margin-top:14px!important}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-learn-pos{font-size:12px}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-learn-grades{margin-top:12px!important;padding-top:12px}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-learn-grades button{min-height:46px!important}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-learn-grades strong{font-size:15px}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-learn-note{font-size:10px}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-learn-meaning{font-size:16px}
 #vocabulary-review .ux-keyboard-note{display:none}
 #word-review #vr-stage{padding:18px!important}
 #word-review #vr-stage .vr-word{font-size:30px!important}
 #word-review #vr-stage .vr-card-heading p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.65}
 #word-review #vr-stats{gap:13px}
 #lookup-learning .lookup-top h2{font-size:25px}
 #word-library #vr-list{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 #word-library .vr-list-card .vr-tag{font-size:10px;white-space:normal;max-width:130px}
 .ui-history-tabs{gap:18px;margin:0 0 18px}
}
@media(max-width:700px) and (max-height:650px){
 #vocabulary-review .ui-word-tabs{margin-bottom:8px!important}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-word-toolbar{margin-bottom:8px}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-word-toolbar select{min-height:38px;padding:7px 10px!important}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-learn-card{padding:14px!important}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-topic-pill{display:none}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-learn-term{font-size:29px!important;margin:4px 0 2px!important}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-learn-prompt{font-size:11px;margin:8px 0!important}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-reveal{min-height:40px;padding:9px 12px;margin:10px 0!important}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-learn-grades{margin-top:10px!important;padding-top:10px}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-learn-grades button{min-height:42px!important;padding:8px 3px}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-learn-note{display:none}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-learn-definition{margin:10px 0}
 #vocabulary-review .pe-word-feedback{margin:8px 0 4px}
 #vocabulary-review .ui-learn-definition blockquote [lang=en]{font-size:15px}
 #vocabulary-review .pe-word-next{min-height:42px}
}
</style>

<style id="writing-experience-style">/* One writing desk: question stays beside the work, secondary controls stay secondary. */
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience="1"]{--wex-top:72px;--wex-line:#d5e0d4;--wex-paper:#fffefa;--wex-ink:#214b3c;max-width:none}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] [hidden]{display:none!important}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience][data-ww-browsing=false]>.ww-heading,
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience]>#ww-resume,
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience]>.ww-compact-note{display:none!important}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .ww-unit{scroll-margin-top:calc(var(--wex-top) + 12px)}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .wex-unit-heading{margin:0 0 20px;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:5px 20px;align-items:center}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .wex-unit-heading h2{font-size:27px;line-height:1.35;margin:3px 0;grid-column:1}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .wex-unit-heading>.ww-badge{grid-column:1;grid-row:2;justify-self:start;background:transparent;padding:0;color:#5e7467;font-weight:500;font-size:12px;display:block}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .wex-unit-heading>p:not(.wex-state){display:none}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .wex-unit-heading .wex-state{display:block!important;grid-column:1;margin:0;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;color:#687b6e}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .wex-back{grid-column:2;grid-row:1 / span 3;align-self:start;border:0;background:none;color:var(--wex-ink);padding:8px 0;min-height:44px;font:inherit;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .wex-workspace{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.95fr) minmax(0,1.05fr);gap:22px;align-items:start}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .wex-reference{min-width:0;position:sticky;top:calc(var(--wex-top) + 14px);max-height:calc(100dvh - var(--wex-top) - 34px);overflow:auto;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#bccfbe transparent;border:1px solid var(--wex-line);border-radius:16px;background:var(--wex-paper)}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .ww-topic{margin:0;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;scroll-margin-top:calc(var(--wex-top) + 14px)}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .ww-topic>summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:17px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--wex-line);font-size:14px;font-weight:650;list-style:none;cursor:pointer;background:#edf3e9}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .ww-topic>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .ww-topic[open]{padding-bottom:0}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .ww-topic[open]>summary{margin-bottom:0}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .wex-topic-meta{font-size:12px;font-weight:400;color:#617568;white-space:nowrap}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .wex-topic-content{padding:18px 20px 12px}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .ww-topic .ww-prompt{margin:0;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;font:18px/1.7 Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;color:#203c30}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .ww-figure{margin:16px 0 4px;text-align:center}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .ww-figure>a{display:block;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;overflow:hidden}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .ww-figure img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:300px;object-fit:contain;margin:auto;background:white;cursor:zoom-in}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .wex-enlarge{border:0;background:none;color:#365e49;font:inherit;font-size:12px;min-height:40px;padding:6px 12px;cursor:zoom-in;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .wex-source{border:0;border-top:1px solid #e2e8dd;margin:12px 0 0;padding:3px 0 0;font-size:12px;color:#64796a;background:transparent;border-radius:0}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .wex-source>summary{padding:10px 0;cursor:pointer;font-weight:500;font-size:12px}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .wex-source p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.75;margin:8px 0}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .ww-reading-prep{margin:0 18px 14px;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--wex-line);padding:0;background:none}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .ww-reading-prep>summary{font-size:12px;padding:13px 0}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .wex-editor{min-width:0;border:1px solid var(--wex-line);border-radius:16px;background:var(--wex-paper);padding:0 20px 16px;scroll-margin-top:calc(var(--wex-top) + 12px)}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .ww-progress{position:sticky;top:var(--wex-top);z-index:2;display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:nowrap;margin:0 -20px 16px!important;padding:9px 14px!important;border:0!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--wex-line)!important;border-radius:16px 16px 0 0!important;background:#f5f7f0!important;box-shadow:none;overflow:visible}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .ww-progress a{flex:1;min-width:0;min-height:42px;border:0;padding:8px 7px;font-size:13px;border-radius:8px;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:0;color:#496454;background:transparent}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .ww-progress a[aria-current]{background:#285f48;color:#fff;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 2px 6px #285f4814}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .ww-progress .wex-recall{display:none}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .ww-step{padding:0!important;border:0;scroll-margin-top:calc(var(--wex-top) + 72px);border-radius:0!important;background:transparent}
#writing-workbench[data-writing-experience] .ww-step h3{font-size:20px;line-height:1.4;margin:2px 0 13px!important}
